description: This file contains test cases for HTTP error handling using pytest, specifically for testing curl behaviors under various error conditions such as partial downloads, protocol downgrades, unclean TLS shutdowns, and resource access errors.

classes.name: TestErrors
classes.description: A pytest test class that includes setup fixtures and multiple test cases focusing on various HTTP error scenarios during curl operations.

methods.name: _class_scope(self, env, httpd, nghttpx)
methods.description: Autouse fixture for class scope setup, managing HTTP version support, starting nghttpx if necessary, and reloading HTTPD configurations.

methods.name: test_05_01_partial_1(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Tests partial file downloads over different protocols, expecting specific error exit codes for incomplete downloads.

methods.name: test_05_02_partial_20(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Downloads multiple files in parallel, verifying all requests complete with expected error codes indicating partial/file reset conditions.

methods.name: test_05_03_required(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat)
methods.description: Checks resource access behavior over HTTP/1.1 and H2 protocols, especially handling protocol downgrade and stream resets.

methods.name: test_05_04_unclean_tls_shutdown(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Verifies curl's handling of unclean TLS shutdowns for different HTTP versions, expecting different responses based on the protocol's robustness to such conditions.
